request: Owner requested faster fetching and all selected stores from zero; Khaadi remains excluded. Two overlapping workers on eligible sources retain shared request spacing, rate-limit cooldown, exact stock/price checks and full 804 Audit.
laam_rule: Active, visible, source-confirmed in-stock clothing only; stitched, unstitched and ready-made included; bags, jewellery and non-clothing excluded
stock_policy: Exclude fully out-of-stock products; retain source-confirmed unavailable variants of included products. LAAM active visible in-stock clothing only.
price_policy: Live variant identity, PKR prices and availability verified; no cached-price fallback on failed verification; sale only where actual payable price is below source compare-at price.
